en.title: Awesome GPT Image 2 Prompts — Free & Open Source
en.subtitle: Curated prompts · Preview images · 1-click copy & generate · Multilingual · Weekly updated
en.featuredNote: Hand-picked for exceptional quality and creativity
en.multilingualIntro: The library is available in multiple languages, with more being added regularly:
en.howToUse:
**Option 1 — Use the website (recommended)**
1. Go to [surgepix.ai/resources/gpt-image-2-prompts]({gallery})
2. Browse or filter by category
3. Click **Copy** to copy the prompt, or **Generate** to create the image directly
**Option 2 — Use prompts in ChatGPT / OpenAI API**
1. Copy any prompt from the library
2. Paste into ChatGPT (with GPT-Image-2 enabled) or the OpenAI Images API
3. Adjust parameters as needed
en.sourceTracing: Community prompts include a direct link back to the original post on X (Twitter), Weibo, Reddit, or other platforms — so you can follow the creator, see the context, and give credit where it's due.
en.about:
GPT-Image-2 is OpenAI's latest image generation model, known for:
- Exceptional text rendering inside images
- Complex multi-element compositions
- Instruction-following for detailed prompts
- High-quality posters, infographics, UI mockups, and character sheets
en.footer: Made with ❤️ by [SurgePix](https://surgepix.ai) · Updated weekly · Free forever
